newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in dull trade.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to be mixed as some investors cash in scrips to repay bank loans before the fiscal year ends on June 30, brokers said.

"The investors will remain cautious in their commitments. There is no good news that can bolster the market," said broker Shakil Rizvi. He said investors were under pressure to repay their bank loans by the end of the year.
The DSE all-share price index dropped 5.18 points or 0.46 percent to 1,118.29 on Thursday. Friday and Saturday are the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
